cookingforblockheads_oven_facing_from_st.conversion: MixinExtras @ModifyReturnValue on OvenBlockEntity.getFacing: the facing of the oven's current block state (BlockKitchen.FACING) when the state has it, else the original answer. Gameplay fix (off by default): the door handles of ovens facing south, east or west (and of dyed ovens) are lit from the block in front of the oven instead of the block to its north. Runtime flag cookingforblockheadsOvenFacingFromState. Helper bons.furious.patch.cookingforblockheads_oven_c49.OvenFacing.
